Social Media post shows that a playground and the pickleball courts at Riverside Park are destroyed due to flood waters.
Tree down across the road_ power lines also blown down.
Tree down off Sewell Creek Road.
A couple trees down on Farmdale Road_ one on a power line.
Flooding along Route 60 in the west end of town. Residential flooding occurring and impassable roads.
County road 60/32 along the Kanawha Turnpike closed due to flooding.
Flooding around businesses in the northeast end of Rainelle.
Fayette Avenue is underwater near the golf course.
Farmdale Road/CR 26 closed due to high water.
Water rescue near Tweetsie Railroad in Blowing Rock due to flooding.
Flooding on West Virginia Highway 20 near the county line.
Facebook photo showed water entering a home in Blowing Rock.
Water over roadway on Thirteenth Street in Rainelle. Roadway is impassable.
Public reported 4.90 inches of rain between 6pm and 8:15pm in the community of Naola.
Rainfall total between 100 am and 600 am EDT.
Forest Haven Drive completely washed out exposing the culvert pipe beneath the road.
Chances Creek Road is completely flooded by flowing water_ which has resulted in an ongoing water rescue. Flooding is also being noted in other parts of the county such as Fancy Gap and Hillsville.
A mudslide occurred near the 600 block of Carrollview Road_ which is close to the intersection with County Top Road.
Thunderstorm winds blew down one tree limb on to the 7000 block of Hunting Creek Road.
Thunderstorm winds blew down one tree along the 1100 block of Cliborne Trail.
Few trees downed and large tree limbs broken. Report relayed by Surry County Parks and Recreation Department.
6 large trees down on power lines in the 2000-3000 block of Goodview Road. 876 customers without power.
Multiple trees down along Brick Church Road.
